verdict.rationale: Scheduled jobs, such as recurring evaluations or reports, are a plausible capability for an agent observability and improvement platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows real-time signal firing, history backfill, CI release scoring, and a CLI that can be called from scripts or CI. None of these is a documented recurring-schedule feature, and wiring the CLI into an external cron is a user-side workaround that earns no credit.
